text:
noah: Hey team, I'm starting next week and trying to map who to ping for common requests. small list: VPN, dedicated GPU quota, 1Password infra vaults, and badge.

reeva: welcome @noah! :wave: for VPN and private VPC networking it's @reeva (networks). I'll open the network request.

sophia: hi @noah 1 GPU quota requests go through compute-requests. use the quota form and cc eng-infra. Link: https://intranet/redwood/compute-requests. Also mention if you need burst or reserved.

infra-bot: Note: GPU quota approvals typically take 2-3 business days during normal cadence.

noah: ok good to know. 1Password infra vaults - who owns invites?

reeva: infra vaults: @sophia is the owner for compute-related entries, but @maria controls the infra group invites. I'll loop maria in shortly.

people-ops: Badge steps posted: https://intranet/redwood/badges. HQ pickup is Tue 9-11am. I'll send the confirmation once it's scheduled.

noah: thanks. last q: who to page if an onboarding provisioning job fails and blocks other new hires?

infra-bot: Oncall rota: this week's infra primary: reeva, backup: sophia. Page #eng-oncall or use the pager. For cross-org blocker, escalate to eng-sre lead.

reeva: and if the provisioning job shows permission denied errors, ping me directly and I can triage the IAM bits. otherwise page oncall.

noah: perfect, thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
